places.name: Manteigaria
places.note: Pastel de nata straight from the oven; eat it standing at the counter.
places.details:
The custard tart specialist locals compare everyone else against. A bell rings when a fresh batch comes out.

Caveat: the Chiado branch gets tour groups around noon, so go early or use another branch.

sources.title: Time Out Lisbon: best pastéis de nata

places.name: Padaria do Bairro
places.note: Sourdough sells out by noon; closed Mondays.
places.details: Neighbourhood sourdough bakery recommended by residents on r/lisbon for its country loaf and cardamom buns.

sources.title: r/lisbon: best bread in town (search snippet)

places.name: Copenhagen Coffee Lab
places.note: Flat white and a cardamom bun; laptop-friendly before 11.
places.details: Nordic-style roaster with several cafés; the Príncipe Real one has the most seating.

excluded.name: Fábrica da Nata
excluded.details: Big branded custard-tart shop on the main tourist axis.
